summary: Architecture and implementation plan for OPEN LANGUAGE: a production-grade multi-language learning Android application featuring Poly the colorful Parrot mascot, 15+ rich language tracks, 10 interactive learning games, structured CEFR curriculum (A1-C2), comprehensive lesson question types, dual voice engine (Android TTS + Gemini AI Voice Tutor), spaced repetition vocabulary notebook, gamification (XP, streaks, coins, hearts, leaderboards), and progress analytics.
